author: Inside Edition
description: Georgina Petridis is raising awareness and teaching others with chronic illnesses how to empower themselves. After years of debilitating symptoms, she was diagnosed with MS. Multiple sclerosis is a chronic disease of the central nervous system, according to Johns Hopkins. Because of her difficult medical journey, she uses her social media platform to educate and teach others to take initiative when it comes to their health. She shares her story with Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: Woman With MS Educates And Empowers The Chronic Illness Community
